name: Queen for a Week
source:
Once upon a time, there was a kingdom called Orabella – once a sanctuary for fairies, now slowly rotting under the plague known as the Black Rose. 

Thrust onto the throne, Princess Linette Orabella must rise as Queen, racing against time to lead and seek the Ministers of the Four Seasonal Courts alongside her brother, Elliot Silvercross. 

They have only one week to save their kingdom… or watch it wither into ruin.

[From [url=https://faereal.itch.io/queen-for-a-week-demo]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
从前，有一个名叫奥拉贝拉的王国——曾经是仙女的庇护所，现在在被称为黑玫瑰的瘟疫下慢慢腐烂。

登上王位后，莱内特·奥拉贝拉公主必须成为女王，与时间赛跑，与她的弟弟埃利奥特·西尔弗克罗斯一起领导和寻找四个季节宫廷的大臣。

他们只有一周的时间来拯救他们的王国……或者眼睁睁地看着它走向毁灭。

[来自[url=https://faereal.itch.io/queen-for-a-week-demo]Itch.io[/url]]
